_about: Public-domain Thomas Secker (1693-1768), Archbishop of Canterbury, for the Word Hoard: his Works (London: Rivington, 1771-1780, twelve volumes: sermons, the Lectures on the Catechism, charges and occasional pieces), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 41 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
